keySigns: A thin visceral pleural line is visible in the right apex with absent lung markings peripheral to it. No mediastinal shift.
comparison: Model primary: pneumothorax (confidence 83%). Rationale: A thin visceral pleural line is visible in the right apex with absent lung markings peripheral to it. No mediastinal shift.

learningPoint: On an erect PA film, small pneumothoraces are easiest to spot at the apex. Look carefully for the pleural line; expiratory films accentuate small PTX.
